english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for cloth or fabric in general.

exampleSentences.english: I bought some cloth to make curtains.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我買咗塊布返去整窗簾。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 faai3 bou3 faan1 heoi3 zing2 coeng1 lim4

english.note: Use this casual shorter word when referring to the physical cloth itself.

exampleSentences.english: I want to buy some fabric to make curtains.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我想買塊布返去整窗簾。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 faai3 bou3 faan1 heoi3 zing2 coeng1 lim2
